neighbours.label: the 'w' / 'aw' continuation token right after a 'Ch…' name fragment (Chuk|w|u…, Chik|w|awa, Chi|w|etel, Ch|aw|la): mid-name pieces of Igbo, Chewa, Shona and Indian names
fire: The striker Samuel Chukwueze scored twice for Nigeria.
Our guest tonight is the novelist Chukwuemeka Ike.
Relief trucks reached the town of Chikwawa on Friday.
The singer Chiwoniso Maraire recorded her first album in Harare.
General Constantino Chiwenga addressed the nation on television.
The paper by Nikhil Chawla and colleagues was widely cited.
The bishop, Emmanuel Chukwuma, opened the new school.
The actress Juhi Chawla appeared in many Hindi films.
quiet: The striker Samuel Eto'o scored twice for Cameroon.
Our guest tonight is the novelist Chinua Achebe.
Relief trucks reached the town of Blantyre on Friday.
The singer Miriam Makeba recorded her first album in Johannesburg.
General Charles Chandler addressed the nation on television.
The paper by Nikhil Chopra and colleagues was widely cited.
The bishop, Emmanuel Okonjo, opened the new school.
The actress Priyanka Chopra appeared in many Hindi films.

notes: Card: peaks 'w' x7, 'aw' x3, 'ak' x3, 'ch' x2: Chuk⟦w⟧uekezie, Chik⟦w⟧awa, Chi⟦w⟧etel, Ch⟦aw⟧la, ch⟦w⟧.net, Pow⟦w⟧ows. Probes: Chukwuma 1.07, Chikwawa 1.00, Chiwetel 1.08, Chawla 0.82; Charles 0.00, Wole 0.04, Mwanza 0.00. Whether the fresh names split the same way was not checked.
